metaDescription: UAE corporate tax support: registration assessment, taxable income computation, reliefs, Qualifying Free Zone Person status, annual return and transfer pricing.
heroIntro: From registration to the annual return: we compute taxable income from your accounts, assess available reliefs and prepare the filing.
overview:
UAE corporate tax starts from your accounting profit, then adjusts for what the law allows and disallows. That only works if your books are kept to a sound standard. We compute taxable income from your accounts, assess reliefs and free zone status, and prepare the return and supporting schedules.

For businesses that have not yet assessed their position, a corporate tax readiness project reviews registration obligations, builds the bridge from accounting profit to taxable income and delivers an action plan.
whatWeDo: Assess registration obligations and support registration on the FTA portal.
Compute taxable income from accounting profit, with adjustments.
Assess available reliefs and Qualifying Free Zone Person status.
Prepare the annual corporate tax return and supporting schedules.
Track related-party transactions and support transfer pricing disclosures.
Plan tax payments and maintain records for the required period.

faqs.q: What is the UAE corporate tax rate?
faqs.a: A standard rate of 9% applies to taxable income above AED 375,000, with a 0% rate below that threshold, subject to the conditions in the law. Rules, reliefs and thresholds can change, so we confirm the current position for your business.

faqs.q: Do free zone companies pay corporate tax?
faqs.a: It depends on whether the company is a Qualifying Free Zone Person and meets the conditions. We assess your status as part of registration and relief assessment.

faqs.q: What does a corporate tax readiness project deliver?
faqs.a: A registration review, a bridge from accounting profit to taxable income, a relief and free zone assessment and an action plan. It typically takes 2 to 3 weeks.
